title: [finding] `component.zod.ts:1179` tells the reader that `component-props-union-arm.test.ts` "pins it from this side" — that file does not exist anywhere in the tree, and the docblock is published
body:
Filed unassigned by the `domain:spec` execution seat while accepting PR #17576 (card #15423). **Recording only — no severity asserted, routing and grading are triage's.** `type` prefilled `Bug` on the class-(b) reading below; ⛔ correct it if that does not carry.

## The site

`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:1179`, in a docblock:

> ` * `component-props-union-arm.test.ts` pins it from this side.`

**That file does not exist, and never has.** Measured on `origin/main` with the instrument that answers the question asked — a **path** listing, ⛔ not a content grep:

```
git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main | grep -c 'component-props-union-arm'   → 0
git grep -n -F 'component-props-union-arm' origin/main                          → 1 hit, and it is
                                        packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:1179 — the claim itself
```

⭐ **Lit controls, same corpus, same instrument** — two sibling test files referenced the same way from a `.zod.ts` and both real:

```
packages/spec/src/automation/state-machine.test.ts          ✓ exists
packages/spec/src/ui/view-union-diagnostics.test.ts          ✓ exists
```

⇒ The zero is a reading. The file name is not a stale path that moved; there is no such test anywhere in the tree.

## Why this is class (b) and not a typo to shrug at

`component.zod.ts` is **published** — `@objectstack/spec`'s `files[]` admits `src/**/*.zod.ts`, so this sentence ships to every consumer. It is a published statement that a guard exists, contradicted by the tree. That is the same shape as #15052 (a `packages/spec` docblock describing engine behaviour the engine does not have), which triage graded class (b), `Bug`, on 2026-09-10.

⚠️ **And the failure direction is the expensive one.** A reader — human or agent — who wants to know whether this union arm is guarded greps the named file, finds nothing, and has to reconstruct the answer from scratch; or worse, trusts the sentence and does not check. #15423 exists **because** exactly that happened once already: `devPlugins`' correct behaviour was re-reported as a defect, at the cost of a grading, a dispatch and a whole PR, because nothing pinned the half an author actually sees.

## ⭐ The part that makes this cheap to fix well

**The guard the sentence describes now genuinely exists** — PR #17576 (landing) adds the `RecordHighlightsField` row of `packages/spec/src/shared/union-author-message-pins.test.ts`, which pins the rendered author-visible message at this very site. So the fix is not "write the missing test": it is to point the sentence at the file that does the job. ⚠️ Verify that on the tip at the time, ⛔ not on this card's word.

## Why PR #17576 did not fold it in — and why the note fallback does not hold

The implementing round surfaced it and declined deliberately, for a reason that is correct: `component.zod.ts` is a published file, so editing it would flip that diff from *publishes nothing* to *publishes* and cost its clean `skip-changeset` measurement. ⛔ Right call.

But it closed the item as "not card-worthy" with **carrier: the next PR touching `component.zod.ts`**. ⚠️ That is not a nameable successor — the rule is that an acceptance note needs a specific PR or person, and "whoever touches this file next" is exactly the case the rule excludes; a finding with no nameable carrier gets closed with 「承接者:无」 written out, ⛔ not left as a note nobody is going to read. ⇒ Filed here instead, so it survives the round that found it.

## What this does NOT claim

- ⛔ No behaviour is wrong. Nothing reddens, nothing is mis-parsed; a docblock sentence is false.
- ⛔ No claim that the sentence was ever true. The file is absent from the tree, ⛔ not deleted from it — this card does not assert which.
- ⛔ No claim about other cross-references in `component.zod.ts` or elsewhere. **A sweep for sibling dead references was NOT run** — that is a bigger and possibly more valuable card, and asserting a clean tree here would be a zero nobody measured.
- **Dedupe.** Full enumeration of the `domain:spec` label set, `state=all`, updated since 2026-07-01 ⇒ **400 unique issues**, title+body grepped for `component-props-union-arm`, `RecordHighlightsField`, `pins it from this side`, and a dead-test-file phrasing. **Zero hits.** Lit control on the same corpus: `component.zod.ts` returned five cards (#14406, #14412, #15110, #15449, #15618) ⇒ the zeros are readings. ⚠️ Declared scope limit: bounded by `since=2026-07-01`. Nearest neighbour is **#15618** (closed — three objectui read-point anchors in `packages/spec` measured wrong), same family of defect, different anchors; ⛔ not a duplicate.
- I assert no severity, no priority and no `domain:*`.
